mapper.insert: insert into media_verify_code (target, channel, scene, code_hash, attempts, used, expires_at, sent_at) values (#{target}, #{channel}, #{scene}, #{codeHash}, 0, 0, #{expiresAt}, now())
mapper.update: update media_verify_code set used = 1, used_at = #{now} where id = #{id} and used = 0
update media_verify_code set attempts = attempts + 1 where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from media_verify_code where target = #{target} and sent_at > #{since}
